description: Sends one unpaid request to a paid route and returns the 402 payment requirements (amount, currency, network, payee, protocol). No payment is made and no credential is sent; the response is the quote for that exact request body.

body.description: JSON request body the quote is computed for (messages or prompt; for /v1/chat/completions also model and max_tokens).

route.description: Paid route path. /v1/* accepts MPP, /x402/* accepts x402.

name: omniprovider_get_quote
title: OmniProvider price quote
